name: Albania Data Center / H.A.P.I. TEDA Tirana data center
developer: Albania Data Center (ADC) / H.A.P.I. Advanced Technologies LTD
notes: TEDA Tirana announced an agreement with H.A.P.I. Advanced Technologies to create a large regional digital data center in the TEDA Tirana area; DCD/Globes reported ADC's 32 MW first phase in the free economic zone near Tirana, with possible expansion to 100 MW and a reported EUR 100 million cost.

name: Host.al Tirana colocation datacenter
notes: Host.al's own pages advertise colocation, VPS and dedicated server hosting from its Albania/Tirana datacenter with redundant power, cooling and 24/7 monitoring; Data Center Map lists the facility in Tirana.

name: Keminet / iRegister Tirana data center
notes: iRegister's own site identifies Keminet Shpk as a Tirana-headquartered web hosting and data center provider offering VPS, dedicated servers and colocation; Data Center Map lists Keminet Shpk at Rr. Abdi Toptani, Tirana.

name: RASH / ANIX Tirana data center
notes: ANIX/RASH pages describe a carrier-grade RASH data center in central Tirana hosting the Albanian Neutral Internet Exchange, with rack space, a meet-me room and ISP/carrier interconnection.

name: ProNet Data Center Kashar
notes: Industry listings identify ProNet Data Center in Kashar/Tirana and include ProNet among Tirana data center providers; no primary operator facility page was found during this pass.
